articles.title: Odelein dies at 58, was first Blue Jackets captain
Utah Earns 4-1 Win Powered by Multiple Milestone Performances
Utah Wraps Back-to-Back against New York Rangers

away.summary: The Utah Mammoth are in great form, having won their first two games of the season. They have a strong lineup with key players returning, including captain Clayton Keller and center Nick Schmaltz, who both reached career milestones in their recent game. Sebastian Cossa, the team's new goaltender, made his NHL debut and earned a win, showing promise.

home.summary: The New Jersey Devils are coming off a 4-2 loss to the Utah Mammoth, but they have a solid lineup with Igor Shesterkin expected to start in goal. Joonas Korpisalo is out due to a lower body injury, but other players are returning from previous games. The Devils will look to bounce back and maintain their strong start to the season.
